anchor.method: FY2026E income statement = 9M-2026 actuals + iterative Q4 estimate; FY2026E balance sheet = 30 Sep 2026 actuals + Q4 growth; FY2027E-FY2030E linked to macro.csv nominal GDP, CPI, policy rate, T-bills, and 10Y bond yield.

q4_2026_loan_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 net loan growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_deposit_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 customer deposit growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_flow_scale.note: Q4-2026 non-interest income and opex run-rate as fraction of 9M-2026.

loan_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ loan growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 2.0%.

deposit_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ deposit growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 0.5%.

yield_on_investments_spread_over_blend_p.note: FY2026E Q4 uses the Q4 364-day bill and 10-year bond yield proxies in cost_of_funds_calibration, blended 50/50, less 4.0 percentage points. FY2027E+ uses 50% macro.csv tbill_364d_pct + 50% govt_bond_yield_pct - 4.0 points. The aggregate fit in checks.md is a calibration guide, not an observed security yield.

yield_on_loans_spread_over_policy_pct.note: FY2026E Q4 uses the 12.57% day-weighted Q4 policy input in cost_of_funds_calibration + 1.0 percentage point; FY2027E+ uses macro.csv policy_rate_pct + 1.0 point. The aggregate interest-income fit in checks.md is a calibration guide, not an observed loan yield.

cost_of_risk_pct.note: FY2026E near zero on 9M-2026 recoveries; normalizes to 1.4-1.5%.

dividend_payout_pct.note: 20.0% of positive PAT is paid only when retained earnings after statutory transfer remain positive after the full proposed payout and post-payout CAR meets target_car_pct; otherwise payout is zero.

target_car_pct.note: Target CAR proxy buffer above 13.0% min_car_pct.

cost_of_funds_tbill_beta.note: Cost of funds moves by 0.18 percentage points per 1 percentage-point move in the 91-day T-bill rate; calibrated to FY2025 and Jan-Sep 2026 in checks.md.

cost_of_funds_intercept_pct.note: 0.7 percentage-point intercept in cost_of_funds_pct = 0.7 + 18% x tbill_91d_pct; same link across scenarios.

cost_of_funds_floor_pct.note: Minimum modeled cost of funds in percentage points.

cost_of_funds_calibration.q4_2026_tbill_91d_basis: Implied Q4 average from FY2026E 91-day bill estimate 5.81% and Jan-Sep actual mean 6.23%, with November-December at 4.52% per shared macro.csv note: (12*5.81 - 9*6.23)/3 = 4.55%. Rounded source inputs; estimate.
cost_of_funds_calibration.jan_sep_2026_basis: Simple mean of Jan-Sep 2026 monthly 91-day interest-equivalent rates; observed calibration input, not the FY2026E macro estimate.
cost_of_funds_calibration.q4_2026_yield_basis: Q4 rate proxies from shared macro.csv: latest 364-day auction (9.447 on 23 Nov 2026) and October 10-year yield (15.01) held for November-December. These are applied as Q4 run-rate inputs, not observed quarter-average yields. The 11.0% policy rate effective 18 Nov is time-weighted with 14.0% before the cut for the Q4 loan-yield input.
cost_of_funds_calibration.q4_2026_policy_rate_basis: Day-weighted Q4 mean: 14.0% from 1 Oct through 17 Nov (48 days) and 11.0% from 18 Nov through 31 Dec (44 days), based on the 18 Nov policy-rate cut in macro.csv; (48*14 + 44*11)/92 = 12.565%, rounded to 12.57%.

statutory_reserve.source: CAL26Q3 Bank statement of financial position and changes in equity; Act 930 s34–35, BoG PDF printed pp30–31
statutory_reserve.method: Opening annual reserve fund divided by paid-up capital determines 50%, 25%, or 12.5% allocation of positive annual after-tax profit. FY2026 incremental transfer deducts actual YTD 1m, floored at zero. Reserve transfer precedes payout gate; no further credit-risk reserve or OCI transfer assumed. Statutory fund is a nonadditive component of other reserves. Other dividend permissions not modeled.
